The crossover with an answer for everything
With the 2015 Kia Sorento, your options are unlimited. It provides an outstanding
combination of design and performance, featuring sophisticated styling along
with an available 290-hp 3.3L Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) V6 engine. With
available third-row seating* and a spacious interior, Sorento can comfortably
accommodate up to seven people. Technologically advanced available features
include Blind-Spot Detection1* and the impressive UVO eServices2* Infotainment
System with voice-command navigation. The Sorento is also equipped with ad-
vanced safety features† designed to ensure your peace of mind. Reflecting Kia’s
commitment to America, the Sorento is proudly built in West Point, Georgia.††
